steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory and repository map to understand the structure of the project.
2. Read the files named in the task, specifically `src/tlv.c` and `src/tlv.h`.
3. Create a new file named `harness_fuzz.c` in the repository root.
4. Include the necessary header file `src/tlv.h` in `harness_fuzz.c`.
5. Define the `int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` function.
6. Declare a `TlvDoc doc` and call `tlv_parse(data, size, &doc)`. If `tlv_parse()` returns `TLV_OK`, also call `tlv_free(&doc)` and `tlv_total_len_of_type(&doc, data[0])`.
7. Compile the harness using the command `clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined harness_fuzz.c src/tlv.c -I . -o /tmp/h`.
8. Once the compilation is successful, say "DONE".
